labels.VERIFIED: read on a primary source this session (vendor's own pricing/docs page, government registry, platform listing page)
labels.REPORTED: third-party source (review site, blog, aggregator, law-firm alert); may be stale or biased
labels.CLAIMED: vendor marketing claim, not independently confirmed

meta.owner_constraints_applied: US delivery 2-8 business days, no China-direct parcels to customers, test-before-stock (10-50 unit batch shipped from home), own brand for the hero (reselling other brands only for add-ons), channels: Amboras store / TikTok Shop / Amazon, $1,800 total budget, free tools first, up to about $100/month
meta.key_structural_finding: Amboras is not Shopify. Every 'one-click' Shopify app (TeemDrop, DSers, Spocket, Zendrop, AutoDS, HyperSKU, Sup, EPROLO) is unusable with Amboras unless the supplier has an API or CSV order import. Suppliers with documented order APIs: CJdropshipping (VERIFIED), Printful and Printify (developer portals reachable, VERIFIED exist), AliExpress Open Platform (portal reachable; dropshipping endpoint details not confirmed). Zendrop and DSers offer MCP servers (VERIFIED on pricing pages) but no documented public order API.

teemdrop.verdict: Not a fit for the hero product. Fit 2/10. Usable at most as a China-side sourcing agent for a bulk batch shipped to Dhruv's home, and even then Alibaba/1688 with Trade Assurance or CJ is better documented.

what_it_is.description: Chinese dropshipping fulfillment and sourcing-agent platform: you list items from its catalog (or request sourcing), it buys from Chinese suppliers, warehouses, QCs and ships to your customers; also POD, custom packaging, 'AI design' tools. Homepage: 'All-in-one, AI-powered supply chain service provider'. [VERIFIED wording, teemdrop.com]
what_it_is.legal_entity: EASYFLOW LOGISTICS LIMITED, UK company no. 16065800, incorporated 7 Nov 2024, registered office Suite 302, 4 Station Square, Cambridge CB1 2GE (a virtual-office style address; the TeemDrop About page says it 'is not a returning address'). SIC 64209 holding company. Accounts made up to 30 Nov 2025. [VERIFIED, UK Companies House + teemdrop.com/about]
what_it_is.operating_location: Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China (Shopify App Store developer location 'Hangzhou, ZJ, CN'; 'Sourcing location: China'). [VERIFIED, apps.shopify.com/teemdrop-1]
what_it_is.history: About page says founder 'Kevin' started a studio in Jinhua in 2008, co-founder 'James' 2009, HQ Hangzhou 2014 with 80+ staff, 2020 '4 hubs | 30,000 m2' warehouses in South & East China. [CLAIMED, teemdrop.com/about]. The current legal entity is under 2 years old and the Shopify app launched 22 May 2025. [VERIFIED]
what_it_is.ownership: No beneficial owners checked (Companies House PSC page not read). UNKNOWN.
what_it_is.scale_claims: '1M+ users', '$100M+ annual sales', '98.5% on-time', '99.99% accuracy'. [CLAIMED, homepage; no independent evidence found]

how_it_works.catalog: TD products (TD SPU IDs) that can be 'listed to store'; 'Winning Products' and 'Hot Selling Products' sections; sourcing requests for anything else. [VERIFIED from seller-dashboard JS strings: 'TeemDrop Products/Winning Products: Products that can be directly listed to store', 'Winning Picks', 'Winning picks periods']
how_it_works.sourcing_agent_model: Dedicated agents (reviewers name Reddy, Galya, Sharon, Poppy); quote, buy from factories, QC photos, pack. [REPORTED, Trustpilot/App Store reviews]
how_it_works.fulfillment_and_warehouses: China warehouses (Hangzhou area per About page). Homepage: '8-12 business day delivery' to US/EU/AU/CA. [CLAIMED/VERIFIED wording]. A TeemDrop blog says it 'introduced a US local warehouse, offering 3-7 day delivery with shipping starting at $0.01' but names no city, state, SKU count or launch date; the About page and pricing page name no US warehouse. [CLAIMED, teemdrop.com/blogs/teemdrop-vs-usadrop-in-2026]. Treat US warehouse as UNVERIFIED.
how_it_works.reel_example_shipping: The Reel's Cloud Puff Pillow: $6.80 product + $17.98 shipping to US, 7-15 days = $24.78. This is a China-direct parcel and fails the house rule (2-8 business days, no China-direct). [CLAIMED in the Reel; not viewed by me]
how_it_works.processing_time_disputes: TeemDrop's own review replies say displayed transit times exclude 1-5 business days of processing and that 1-3 day processing applies to 'about 80% of orders'. Real door-to-door is therefore longer than shown. [VERIFIED, TeemDrop replies on Shopify App Store reviews]
how_it_works.branding: Blind packaging, custom packaging, OEM/ODM, POD. Fees not published. [CLAIMED, Shopify listing + homepage]
how_it_works.pricing: $0/month, 'no subscriptions or hidden fees'; you pay product + shipping; first top-up 3% bonus (prepaid wallet). Margin is built into product prices. [VERIFIED, teemdrop.com/dropshipping-fulfillment-pricing + dashboard strings]
how_it_works.integrations: Shopify App Store app is the only listed integration (apps.shopify.com/teemdrop-1). Homepage also mentions WooCommerce, eBay, Etsy. TikTok Shop: only a TikTok logo, no stated integration. No public API documented. No Amboras. [VERIFIED for Shopify; CLAIMED for others]

winning_products_list.how_chosen: Not disclosed. Dashboard groups them as 'Winning Picks' by 'periods' (batches), and the homepage says 'AI-analyzed potentials'. No sales counts, order counts, store counts or source data are exposed in the dashboard strings. Trustpilot reviewers say agents send 'lists of winning products'. Conclusion: curated marketing list from a supplier that profits when you list and order its items, not an independent sales-data signal. [VERIFIED absence of data fields in bundle; interpretation is mine]
winning_products_list.public_access: No. seller.teemdrop.com/* returns a 1.6 KB single-page-app shell for every route; data loads only after login. teemdrop.com/winning-products returns 404. A non-subscriber cannot read the list without creating an account (free sign-up). [VERIFIED, HTTP fetches 2026-11-15]

reviews.shopify_app_store: 4.9 stars, 230 reviews (222 five-star, 5 one-star), launched 22 May 2025. [VERIFIED, apps.shopify.com/teemdrop-1]. The five 1-star reviews (US, UK, NL merchants, Oct 2025 - Sep 2026): orders cancelled without authorization; 2+ week shipping that cost a seller their Amazon US account; refund fee for cancelled orders; >4 days to leave warehouse; '3-5 day' delivery unrealistic; AliExpress-level quality. [VERIFIED]
reviews.trustpilot: 299 reviews, 91% five-star, BUT banner: 'This company's rating is unavailable due to a breach of our guidelines' and 'We've removed a number of fake reviews for this company.' Recent 1-stars (Oct-Nov 2026): paid product never shipped; chasing quotes and order sync. [VERIFIED via WebFetch of trustpilot.com and ca.trustpilot.com]. Note: CJdropshipping carries the same Trustpilot warning, so this is common among Chinese agents, but it means the 5-star volume cannot be trusted.
reviews.reddit: No Reddit threads about TeemDrop found. [searched; none surfaced]
reviews.content_marketing: TeemDrop publishes many comparison posts ranking itself above Spocket, USAdrop etc., and a blogspot site 'teemdropdropshipping.blogspot.com'; influencer Reels like @gianni.ecom are the typical acquisition channel. Treat as paid promotion unless disclosed otherwise. [REPORTED/interpretation]

red_flags: Trustpilot rating suspended for guideline breach; fake reviews removed (VERIFIED).
Legal entity is a UK holding company formed Nov 2024 at a shared office address; operations in Hangzhou; no US entity found (VERIFIED).
Delivery claims conflict: 8-12 business days (homepage, About) vs 3-7 days 'US local warehouse' (blog only), and displayed times exclude 1-5 days processing (VERIFIED from its own replies).
Reel example ships 7-15 days from China at $17.98 shipping for a 1,280 g item: fails the 2-8 day rule and the FTC Mail Order Rule exposure is on the seller.
'Winning products' are chosen by the supplier itself with no disclosed data; incentive conflict.
Prepaid wallet top-up model; one reviewer reports a fee to get refunds on cancelled orders (VERIFIED review).
Shopify-only integration, no public API: cannot automate with Amboras.
teemdrop.use_if_any: Only as one of several quotes for a bulk/sample batch (shipped China to Dhruv's home), after a sample, with written defect/return terms. Never as the customer-facing fulfillment for the hero.

reel_store_claims.what_the_reel_showed: A store named 'mellow' built with an AI Shopify app ('Stack'), selling 'CloudAlign Pillow' at $54.99 (crossed $100), '(46,040)' star reviews, '#1 Selling TikTok Pillow', '#1 Best-Selling Pillow of 2025'. [CLAIMED in the Reel as described by the owner; I did not view the Reel]
reel_store_claims.the_names_belong_to_a_real_brand: 'mellow' and 'CloudAlign' are a real US brand: MELLOW LLC, mellowsleep.com, sells the 'CloudAlign(TM) Pillow' at $49.99 with compare-at $100 and states 'The #1 best-selling ergonomic pillow of 2025'; its catalog also has CloudAlign Mini, CloudAlign Mattress Topper and 'Puff Pillows'. A TikTok Shop listing and many advertorial 'CloudAlign review' pages exist. [VERIFIED, mellowsleep.com homepage and /products.json, 2026-11-15]. So the Reel store copies another company's store name, trademarked product name, compare-at price and superlative claim. That is trademark infringement / passing-off risk and violates CLAUDE.md sections 2 and 7 (no copying branding, claims or trademarked designs). Mellow's page itself also references a 'patented SwitchFit' dual-height design in third-party coverage [REPORTED], so a copy may also raise patent risk.

review_count_46040.assessment: A brand-new store cannot have 46,040 genuine reviews of its own. The count is either imported from another seller (AliExpress/Amazon/the real brand) or fabricated. I could not find the 46,040 figure on mellowsleep.com (its homepage shows '130,948+ Happy Sleepers', not a review count), so its origin is UNKNOWN.
review_count_46040.law: FTC Trade Regulation Rule on the Use of Consumer Reviews and Testimonials, 16 CFR Part 465, announced 14 Aug 2024, effective 21 Oct 2024 [REPORTED by multiple law-firm alerts; FTC final rule PDF at ftc.gov]. 465.2 bans writing, creating, buying or disseminating fake or false consumer reviews (including AI-generated ones and reviews from people with no experience of the product) when the business knew or should have known. Civil penalties up to about $53,088 per violation after the Jan 2025 inflation adjustment [REPORTED; earlier figure $51,744]. The proposed separate 'review hijacking' ban (repurposing reviews of a substantially different product) was DROPPED from the final rule, but the FTC has already sued a company over repurposed reviews under Section 5 and can still treat imported reviews that misrepresent the store's own customer experience as deceptive [REPORTED, Crowell & Moring alert]. Fake social-proof indicators and unsubstantiated '#1 best-selling' claims are also Section 5 deceptive-advertising exposure. Review-import apps are legal tools; importing other sellers' reviews and presenting them as this store's customers is the problem.
review_count_46040.platform_risk: TikTok Shop's US Order Packaging Requirements (3 Sep 2026) ban review-bait inserts and 'dropshipping directly from other retailers to customers' [REPORTED, relevantaudience.com citing PPC Land; Seller Academy text not read]. Meta and TikTok ad review commonly reject unsubstantiated superlatives [REPORTED general knowledge, not checked this session].

reel_store_claims.economics_sanity_check: Reel numbers: $24.78 landed (product + shipping, China-direct, 7-15 days) vs $54.99 price leaves about $30 before card/platform fees, refunds and ads; with a typical paid-social cost per purchase this is thin, and the delivery time is non-compliant with the house rule. Must be run through scripts/economics.py, not prose. A 1,280 g pillow is also expensive to air-ship in a 10-50 unit test batch. Bedding/stuffed-article labeling and registration laws in several US states may apply to pillows (not researched this session; check before choosing bedding).
reel_store_claims.conclusion: The Reel demonstrates a 'clone a real brand, import social proof, China-direct dropship' playbook. Every element breaks a house rule (premium, US 2-8 day delivery, own brand, no copied claims, no fake reviews) and carries FTC and trademark exposure. Do not replicate.

platforms.name: TeemDrop
platforms.winning_signal: Curated 'Winning Picks' by period, chosen by the supplier; no sales data exposed (VERIFIED absence in dashboard bundle)
platforms.us_warehouse: CLAIMED in one blog ('US local warehouse'), no location; not on About or pricing page
platforms.delivery_days_us: 8-12 business days (CLAIMED homepage); Reel item 7-15 days; plus 1-5 days processing (VERIFIED in its own review replies)
platforms.branding: Blind packaging, custom packaging, OEM/ODM, POD (CLAIMED; fees unpublished)
platforms.pricing: $0/month; product + shipping; prepaid wallet (VERIFIED)
platforms.integrations: Shopify app (VERIFIED); Woo/eBay/Etsy (CLAIMED); no TikTok Shop, Amazon, Amboras
platforms.reputation: Shopify 4.9/230 (VERIFIED); Trustpilot rating suspended for guideline breach, fake reviews removed (VERIFIED); 1-star themes: unauthorized cancellations, 2-week shipping, refund fees
platforms.fit_reason: China-direct timing, supplier-curated 'winners', suspended Trustpilot rating, Shopify-only: fails the 2-8 day and own-data rules.

platforms.name: CJdropshipping
platforms.type: supplier/fulfillment (China + overseas warehouses, sourcing agent, POD)
platforms.winning_signal: Trending/hot lists are CJ-curated; not a research tool. Use only for sourcing.
platforms.us_warehouse: Yes, multiple US warehouses (REPORTED); stock is limited to pre-stocked SKUs and may not cover every variant (REPORTED). API exposes per-warehouse inventory ('Query Inventory by Product ID' with sub-warehouse list) and warehouse list endpoint (VERIFIED, CJ developer docs)
platforms.delivery_days_us: US warehouse: about 2-5 to 3-8 business days (REPORTED, several 2026 reviews); China CJPacket 7-15 days (REPORTED)
platforms.branding: Custom packaging, logo inserts, POD, photo/video shooting; paid, and custom packaging must be pre-stocked in CJ's warehouse (REPORTED)
platforms.pricing: Free to join; pay product + shipping + optional services (REPORTED); some sources list optional paid tiers
platforms.api: Yes. Public REST API: products, per-warehouse inventory, freight/shipping methods by SKU, createOrderV2/V3 with fromCountryCode (ship-from country, e.g. US), logisticName, storageId (warehouse ID), balance payment, tracking, webhooks, sandbox (VERIFIED, developers.cjdropshipping.com). Cost/rate limits on 'Points Resource Rules' page not read.
platforms.integrations: Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon, eBay, Wix, WooCommerce, Etsy and others (REPORTED); API for custom stores like Amboras (VERIFIED API exists)
platforms.reputation: Shopify app about 4.9 from about 2,900 reviews (REPORTED, Oct 2026); Trustpilot 13,488 reviews but rating suspended for guideline breach / fake reviews removed (VERIFIED); complaints cluster on processing delays and inconsistent agents (REPORTED)
platforms.fit_reason: Only supplier here with a documented order API that can force ship-from-US and pick the US warehouse, so Claude/Dhruv can wire it to Amboras; also handles samples and branding; check stock per variant.

platforms.name: Zendrop
platforms.type: supplier/fulfillment (China fulfillment + US supplier marketplace + US 3PL)
platforms.winning_signal: Curated trending/product lists (CLAIMED); no disclosed sales source
platforms.us_warehouse: Yes: 'Ships from US' filter for US suppliers; also a US 3PL service (VERIFIED, Zendrop help center + pricing page)
platforms.delivery_days_us: US suppliers: 1-3 business days processing (up to 5 in Q4) + 3-5 days transit (VERIFIED, Zendrop help article); China fulfillment slower
platforms.branding: US suppliers do NOT offer custom branding (VERIFIED help article); custom branding on Zendrop Fulfillment requires paid plan
platforms.pricing: Free $0 (limited, no automated fulfillment); Pro $49/mo; Plus $79/mo (VERIFIED, zendrop.com/pricing)
platforms.api: No public API listed; offers an 'MCP Server' to connect AI agents to your store (VERIFIED pricing page)
platforms.integrations: Shopify, Wix, TikTok Shop, ClickFunnels (VERIFIED); no Amboras
platforms.reputation: Generally solid for US-supplier speed; not checked on Trustpilot this session
platforms.fit_reason: Fast US suppliers and native TikTok Shop, but US items are other people's unbranded/branded goods (add-ons only per house rule) and no Amboras path.

platforms.name: AutoDS
platforms.type: automation layer + supplier aggregator + product research add-on
platforms.winning_signal: Hand-picked and trending products, TikTok ad spy (CLAIMED); add-on 'Product finding hub' $14.97/mo
platforms.us_warehouse: Depends on underlying supplier (AliExpress US stock, Amazon, Walmart, CJ etc.); AutoDS also has its own fulfillment program (REPORTED)
platforms.pricing: 3-day trial for about $1; plan prices not visible in scraped page; add-ons $9.90-$39.97/mo (VERIFIED pricing page partly)
platforms.integrations: Shopify, Facebook, Etsy, WooCommerce, eBay, Amazon, Wix, TikTok Shop (VERIFIED); no Amboras
platforms.reputation: Large user base; not checked this session
platforms.fit_reason: Automation for multi-store resellers; the owner can build his own automation and AutoDS cannot reach Amboras.

platforms.name: Spocket
platforms.winning_signal: Curated catalog; no sales data
platforms.us_warehouse: Many suppliers ship from US/EU; Spocket claims about 80% US/EU suppliers (CLAIMED, relayed)
platforms.delivery_days_us: 2-5 or 3-6 days for domestic suppliers (REPORTED); some reviewers report late shipments despite US labeling (REPORTED)
platforms.branding: Branded invoicing on all plans (VERIFIED); product branding depends on supplier
platforms.pricing: Starter $39.99/mo, Professional $59.99, Empire $99.99, Unicorn $299.99; 7-day trial (VERIFIED)
platforms.integrations: Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon, Squarespace, eBay, BigCommerce, Ecwid, Wix, Square (VERIFIED); TikTok Shop only via Shopify (REPORTED); no Amboras
platforms.reputation: Mixed; delivery reliability varies by supplier
platforms.fit_reason: Good for fast US add-ons, but you resell other brands, it costs $40+/mo, and it cannot connect to Amboras.

platforms.name: Alibaba / 1688 (+ sourcing agent or Trade Assurance)
platforms.winning_signal: None (supply side only)
platforms.us_warehouse: Generally no (some Alibaba sellers hold US stock); goods ship China to you or your 3PL
platforms.delivery_days_us: Air express to Dhruv's home about 5-10 days typical (not verified this session); then Dhruv ships domestically 2-5 days
platforms.branding: Yes: logo, custom packaging, OEM/ODM at low MOQs, the real path to an own brand
platforms.pricing: Free to use; MOQs and sample fees per supplier; 1688 needs an agent (BuckyDrop, others)
platforms.api: Not needed for a batch model
platforms.integrations: None needed (bulk to home, then any store)
platforms.reputation: Supplier-by-supplier; use verified/Trade Assurance suppliers and samples
platforms.fit_reason: Fits 'test before stock' exactly: own-branded 10-50 unit air batch to Dhruv's home, customers get 2-5 day US domestic shipping.

platforms.name: Temu / TikTok Shop / Amazon sellers as suppliers (retail arbitrage)
platforms.winning_signal: n/a
platforms.branding: No; their packaging and invoices reach your customer
platforms.pricing: Retail
platforms.reputation: TikTok Shop US packaging rules (3 Sep 2026) ban dropshipping directly from other retailers to customers (REPORTED); Amazon's drop-shipping policy prohibits buying from another online retailer and having it ship to your customer (REPORTED, long-standing policy); Temu terms reportedly restrict commercial resale (REPORTED)
platforms.fit_reason: Violates platform policies and the blind-shipping rule.

platforms.name: Faire
platforms.winning_signal: Brand bestseller badges (wholesale demand, not consumer)
platforms.us_warehouse: Brands ship from their own locations (many US)
platforms.delivery_days_us: Wholesale to you; not a dropship service
platforms.pricing: Free for retailers; brand-set minimums; Net 60 for eligible retailers (REPORTED, Faire help center)
platforms.reputation: Strong; online retailers must show a website and some brands sell only to brick-and-mortar; orders blocked if you sell mainly on Amazon/eBay/Etsy (REPORTED)
platforms.fit_reason: Wholesale inventory of other brands, no dropship; at most an add-on source later.

best_combinations.name: CJ US warehouse + free real-sales stack
best_combinations.sourcing: CJdropshipping, filtered to products with US-warehouse stock; verify stock per variant and freight via API (fromCountryCode=US, storageId); order samples and one test order to a US address.
best_combinations.research: DataForSEO Amazon bought_past_month (already connected) + Amazon Best Sellers/Movers & Shakers + TikTok Shop 'sold' counts + EchoTik free (upgrade to Pro about $14.90/mo billed yearly only when the weekly scanner needs its API) + Foreplay for ad evidence.
best_combinations.why: Only combination that meets 2-8 day US delivery, gives Amboras an API path (Dhruv's software edge), and grounds 'winning' in real sales rather than ad likes.
best_combinations.caveats: CJ US stock is limited and often generic; Trustpilot rating suspended; custom packaging must be pre-stocked. Branding a CJ item is lighter than a true own brand.

best_combinations.name: Own-brand micro-batch: Alibaba (Trade Assurance) or 1688 via BuckyDrop/agent, air-shipped 10-50 units to Dhruv
best_combinations.sourcing: Sample from 2-3 factories, then a small branded batch air-shipped to Dhruv's home; Dhruv ships orders with USPS (2-5 days domestic). CJ or TeemDrop can be extra quote sources for the batch only.
best_combinations.monthly_cost: $0 tools; cash goes to samples and batch (inside the $250 samples + $300 working capital lines)
best_combinations.why: Matches the CLAUDE.md test-before-stock plan and builds a real own brand with custom packaging; customer delivery is US-domestic.
best_combinations.caveats: Dhruv does fulfillment by hand; duties/tariffs and air freight must go through economics.py; light, small products only.

best_combinations.name: US print-on-demand for desk-setup products
best_combinations.sourcing: Printful (US facilities, API) or Printify (cheaper, API) for desk mats or printable accessories, as a hero add-on or a branded custom kit component.
best_combinations.research: Etsy shop sales counts + Amazon bought_past_month for desk-mat queries + EchoTik.
best_combinations.why: Zero inventory, US-made, own designs, API reachable from Amboras; fits Dhruv's desk-setup knowledge.
best_combinations.caveats: POD margins are thin and categories are crowded; must pass the cushion rule.

best_combinations.name: Zendrop US suppliers (or Spocket) for add-ons on TikTok Shop
best_combinations.sourcing: Zendrop 'Ships from US' items (1-3 day processing + 3-5 day transit) as kit add-ons; Zendrop integrates TikTok Shop natively.
best_combinations.why: Fastest US add-on supply with a TikTok Shop connector.
best_combinations.caveats: US suppliers offer no custom branding (resale of others' goods, add-ons only); no Amboras connection; TikTok Shop forbids shipping straight from other retailers.

best_combinations.name: One-month paid validation sprint (optional, within $100/mo cap)
best_combinations.research: One month of Dropship.io Basic ($39) for competitor Shopify-store sales estimates, or Kalodata Starter (about $46) for TikTok Shop, run only after Gate 1 shortlist exists.
best_combinations.why: Cross-checks free signals before committing sample money.
best_combinations.caveats: Both are modeled estimates, not verified sales; label ESTIMATED.
